findings.summary: Answer on the controlFrames pin: intended and recorded (ADR-0445 2026-11-22 rule 3 line: a no-listener realm-uncaught error runs the child's fatal terminal, not the default Worker report; 2026-11-23 line: after the error dispatch, cancelable). Producer: the child's worker-stdio writer emits one `control:stdio-order` frame per committed stdout/stderr chunk (order = chunks committed on both streams); consumer: ProcessManager `_startIpc` → outputReceiver.acceptOrderFrame releases chunks in that order. Change: the report is now a child stderr chunk (frame 2, order 1, contiguous after stdout 0) instead of parent-side `_workerError` text pushed on stderr without a frame; exit 1 is the child's exit request after the dispatch microtask (ErrorEvent canceled) instead of the parent's uncanceled-ErrorEvent failure; still one exit, one terminate. Protocol code untouched; the other specs on it (kernel-process-terminal-drain.spec.ts, worker-stdio-drain/process-manager/terminal-drain fault tests, worker_threads) pass unedited.
